steps.en: Install the CLI and scaffold a working example suite
steps.zh: 安装 CLI 并生成一套可跑的示例评测
steps.code: npm install -g promptfoo · promptfoo init --example getting-started

steps.en: Declare prompts, providers, test cases and assertions in one YAML file
steps.zh: 在一份 YAML 里声明 prompt、provider、测试用例和断言

steps.en: Run the suite and open the results
Calls every prompt × provider with your own keys and grades each assertion, judge rubric included
steps.zh: 用你自己的 key 调用每个 prompt × provider，逐条给断言判分

steps.en: Serves a side-by-side matrix in a local web viewer, pass/fail per cell
steps.zh: 在本地 Web 查看器里呈现并排矩阵，每格标出通过/失败

value.en: A prompt change that degrades quality now fails promptfoo eval in CI, before it ships
value.zh: 让质量退化的 prompt 改动会在 CI 里被 promptfoo eval 挡下，而不是上线后才暴露
